verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a passing reference to 'prompt engineering' (linked to a prompt hub) as something a self-hosted instance supports. Nothing in the pack documents prompt versioning, or pushing prompt changes to production without a code deploy. A generic prompt-engineering mention is adjacent to this story, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.
